_doc: Gate boxes for train_fast --gate-boxes (ramp-visit logging, ledger 'the GATE BENCHMARK', 2026-09-12). A box is an axis-aligned volume around a ramp the greedy dive skips; an episode HITS if its hull origin enters any box; only episodes that spawned at geodesic >= spawn_d_min count, so a curriculum spawn placed on the ramp is not a visit. Boxes come from the record line's push-back contacts (tools/bev_potential.py's ramp-contact rule) on surf_src_celestial (both mirror sides of the fork, plane y = 552) and from the finisher exitABS round 9's contacts past the wall on surf_src_cannonball.
